$comment: Shell-only hooks configuration - Node.js hooks disabled. Run setup.sh after installing Node.js to enable full functionality.

hooks.command: bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/session/on-session-start.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/session/on-session-start.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'

bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/session/on-session-end.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/session/on-session-end.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'

bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/stop-workflow.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/stop-workflow.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'

bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-workflow-complete.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-workflow-complete.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'

bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-user-prompt.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-user-prompt.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'
bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/tools/pre-bash.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/tools/pre-bash.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'
bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/tools/pre-write.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/tools/pre-write.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'

bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-task-start.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-task-start.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'

bash -c 'ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}}"; if [ -f "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-task-complete.sh" ]; then "$ROOT/hooks/workflow/on-task-complete.sh"; else echo "{\"continue\":true}"; fi'
